outlets_coordinates_valid.name: outlets_coordinates_valid
outlets_coordinates_valid.value: ("outlets"."latitude" is null and "outlets"."longitude" is null) or ("outlets"."latitude" between -90 and 90 and "outlets"."longitude" between -180 and 180)

attendance_settings_thresholds_non_negat.name: attendance_settings_thresholds_non_negative
attendance_settings_thresholds_non_negat.value: ("attendance_settings"."face_match_threshold" is null or "attendance_settings"."face_match_threshold" >= 0) and ("attendance_settings"."liveness_threshold" is null or "attendance_settings"."liveness_threshold" >= 0)

outside_duty_window_valid.name: outside_duty_window_valid
outside_duty_window_valid.value: "outside_duty_requests"."ends_at" is null or "outside_duty_requests"."starts_at" is null or "outside_duty_requests"."ends_at" > "outside_duty_requests"."starts_at"

products_brand_sku_unique.name: products_brand_sku_unique
products_brand_sku_unique.where: "products"."deleted_at" is null and "products"."sku" is not null
